```plato
    // A frame-local point mapped to world coordinates: the frame origin displaced
    // along its own axes by the local coordinates.
    PointInFrame(f: Frame3D, local: Point3D): Point3D
        => (f.Origin.X + f.XAxis.Vector.X * local.X + f.YAxis.Vector.X * local.Y + f.ZAxis.Vector.X * local.Z,
            f.Origin.Y + f.XAxis.Vector.Y * local.X + f.YAxis.Vector.Y * local.Y + f.ZAxis.Vector.Y * local.Z,
            f.Origin.Z + f.XAxis.Vector.Z * local.X + f.YAxis.Vector.Z * local.Y + f.ZAxis.Vector.Z * local.Z);
```
